meta.title: Critical/High Issue Resolution & Regression Tests
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Resolve all CRITICAL and HIGH severity findings from Stories 10.1.2-10.1.4 with corresponding regression tests to prevent future regressions.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: All CRITICAL severity findings resolved, code passes ruff/mypy, YAML updated
All HIGH severity findings resolved, code passes ruff/mypy, YAML updated
Each resolved CRITICAL/HIGH finding has regression test in tests/live/audit/test_{module}_regressions.py
All regression tests pass when run with pytest
Audit summary report generated showing totals, resolution status, and test coverage
Medium/Low findings documented with deferral justification

key-tasks.task: Aggregate all findings from previous stories, filter CRITICAL/HIGH
Resolve CRITICAL findings with fixes and static analysis verification
Resolve HIGH findings with fixes and static analysis verification
Create regression tests for each resolved issue
Final verification (ruff, mypy, all tests pass)

architecture-context.pattern: CRITICAL - Must fix before any production use HIGH - Must fix before production deployment MEDIUM - Should fix, can defer with justification LOW - Nice to have, low priority
architecture-context.constraint: All CRITICAL/HIGH must have regression tests before marking RESOLVED
